stages.title: Tokens & Byte-Pair Encoding (BPE)
stages.objective: Understand how text becomes discrete token IDs, build a BPE tokenizer from scratch, and analyze token economics and context budgets.
stages.completion_criteria: Pass all BPE encoding/decoding and token budgeting tests.

planned_challenges.title: Byte-Pair Encoding (BPE) Tokenizer from Scratch
planned_challenges.objective: Implement subword vocabulary learning, frequency-based pair merging, string encoding to token IDs, and decoding token IDs back to strings.
planned_challenges.expected_outcome: A pure Python BPE tokenizer class handling vocabulary creation, merges, encoding, and decoding.

planned_challenges.title: Token Economics, Special Tokens & Context Budgeting
planned_challenges.objective: Handle special tokens (<bos>, <eos>, <pad>, <unk>), compute token-to-byte compression ratios, and build a context budget manager for backend requests.
planned_challenges.expected_outcome: A TokenBudgetManager that calculates prompt/completion token limits and formats system/user prompts safely.

stages.title: Context Windows & Attention Mechanics
stages.objective: Master Query-Key-Value attention math, causal autoregressive masking, context length constraints, and KV caching for fast inference.
stages.completion_criteria: Pass all matrix attention, causal masking, and KV-cache benchmark tests.

planned_challenges.title: Scaled Dot-Product Self-Attention Engine
planned_challenges.objective: Implement Q, K, V projections, scaled dot-product scoring (QK^T / sqrt(d_k)), causal triangular masking (future token blinding), and softmax attention distribution.
planned_challenges.expected_outcome: A self-attention module calculating correct attention weights and weighted value outputs in pure Python/matrix math.

planned_challenges.title: Context Window Limits & KV-Cache Engine
planned_challenges.objective: Implement context window slicing, sliding-window attention, and a KV-Cache manager that avoids O(N^2) recomputation during autoregressive token generation.
planned_challenges.expected_outcome: A KVCache implementation that stores and appends Key/Value tensors per token step, reducing step complexity from O(N) to O(1).

stages.title: Transformer Architecture & Forward Pass
stages.objective: Build the core components of a decoder-only Transformer: embeddings, positional encodings, multi-head attention, residual connections, and output logits.
stages.completion_criteria: Pass forward-pass tensor dimension checks and next-token prediction tests.

planned_challenges.title: Embeddings, Positional Encodings & Multi-Head Split
planned_challenges.objective: Implement token embedding lookup, sinusoidal positional encodings, and multi-head attention projection/concatenation.
planned_challenges.expected_outcome: A MultiHeadAttention block with residual skip connections and normalization.

planned_challenges.title: Decoder-Only Mini-Transformer Block & Logits Generation
planned_challenges.objective: Assemble a full Decoder-only Transformer layer (MHA + Feed-Forward Network + LM Head) that maps input token sequences to unnormalized vocabulary logits.
planned_challenges.expected_outcome: A MiniTransformer forward pass producing [batch, seq_len, vocab_size] logits.

stages.title: Decoding & Sampling Strategies (Temperature & Top-P)
stages.objective: Master how models convert raw logits into actual words: temperature scaling, Top-K filtering, Top-P (nucleus) sampling, and end-to-end autoregressive generation.
stages.completion_criteria: Pass all temperature scaling, nucleus sampling distribution tests, and text generation loop.

planned_challenges.title: Logit Transformation, Numerical Softmax & Temperature Scaling
planned_challenges.objective: Implement numerically stable Softmax and Temperature scaling (logits / T), demonstrating greedy argmax (T->0), balanced sampling (T=0.7), and high entropy (T=2.0).
planned_challenges.expected_outcome: A TemperatureSampler function passing probability distribution and entropy tests.

planned_challenges.title: Top-K and Top-P (Nucleus) Sampling Engine
planned_challenges.objective: Implement Top-K filtering and Top-P (cumulative probability cutoff) sampling to prevent low-probability tail hallucinations while preserving creativity.
planned_challenges.expected_outcome: A TopKTopPSampler class that correctly truncates and renormalizes probability distributions.

planned_challenges.title: End-to-End Autoregressive Generation Pipeline
planned_challenges.objective: Wire together Tokenizer + Transformer + KV-Cache + Temperature/Top-P Sampler into a full inference generation loop that outputs streamed text.
planned_challenges.expected_outcome: A complete generator function that takes prompt text, streams next tokens, and stops on <eos> or max_tokens.
